syn.note: meeting 泛指見面開會；interview 特指面試或訪談

ex.en: She is the best candidate for the job.
ex.zh: 她是這份工作最好的人選。

syn.note: applicant 只要投履歷就是；candidate 通常指被考慮的人選
nominee 指被提名參選或得獎的人

ex.en: Please send your resume to HR.
ex.zh: 請將履歷寄給人資部。

syn.note: CV 英式常用，通常較長、詳列學經歷；resume 美式常用，較精簡

ex.en: She applied for the sales position.
ex.zh: 她應徵了業務職位。

syn.note: job 口語泛指工作；position 較正式，指職位
post 較正式，多見於公告與英式用法

ex.en: The salary is negotiable.
ex.zh: 薪水可以商量。

syn.note: pay 泛指報酬，口語常用
wage 多指時薪或週薪；salary 指固定月薪或年薪

ex.en: You can pay by credit card.
ex.zh: 你可以用信用卡付款。

usage: pay 三態：pay, paid, paid

ex.en: The minimum wage will increase next year.
ex.zh: 最低工資明年會調漲。

usage: wage 多用於按時計薪的工作

ex.en: The job offers good benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作的福利很好。

syn.note: advantage 指勝過他人的優勢
perk 口語，指公司福利如免費午餐

ex.en: Employees will receive a year-end bonus.
ex.zh: 員工將收到年終獎金。

ex.en: She asked her boss for a raise.
ex.zh: 她向老闆要求加薪。

senses.en: She was raised in Taipei.

usage: raise 及物（需受詞），rise 不及物

ex.en: He got a promotion last month.
ex.zh: 他上個月升職了。

syn.note: advancement 較正式，指職涯發展

ex.en: She was promoted to manager.
ex.zh: 她被升為經理。

syn.note: advance 較正式，常用於職涯 advance one's career
upgrade 多指產品、座位、設備升級

ex.en: He plans to retire next year.
ex.zh: 他計畫明年退休。

syn.note: step down 指辭去職位，不一定是退休

ex.en: She resigned from her position.
ex.zh: 她辭去了職位。

senses.meaning: resign oneself to 只好接受

syn.note: quit 口語；resign 正式，常用於正式提出辭呈
step down 多用於高階職位

ex.en: He quit his job to start his own company.
ex.zh: 他辭職去創業了。

syn.note: give up 指放棄做某事

usage: quit 三態同形：quit, quit, quit

ex.en: The company fired three employees last month.
ex.zh: 公司上個月開除了三名員工。

senses.en: A fire broke out in the warehouse.

syn.note: lay off 指因公司因素裁員，不是員工的錯

ex.en: All new staff are trained for two weeks.
ex.zh: 所有新員工都要受訓兩週。

senses.en: The train leaves at 8:15.

syn.note: coach 多指一對一或運動指導

ex.en: All new staff must attend training.
ex.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加訓練。

syn.note: instruction 指教學或操作說明
coaching 指一對一的指導與輔導

ex.en: The trainees will shadow senior staff this week.
ex.zh: 受訓人員本週會跟著資深員工學習。

syn.note: apprentice 多指技術工的學徒

usage: -ee 結尾多指「被…的人」

ex.en: We are hiring two summer interns.
ex.zh: 我們正在招募兩名暑期實習生。

syn.note: trainee 指正在受訓的新員工

ex.en: She did an internship at a bank last summer.
ex.zh: 她去年夏天在銀行實習。

ex.en: Do you have any sales experience?
ex.zh: 你有任何業務經驗嗎？

syn.note: background 指教育、工作等整體經歷
expertise 強調專業技能深度

ex.en: Good communication skills are required for this position.
ex.zh: 這個職位需要良好的溝通能力。

syn.note: ability 較廣，指天生或學來的能力

ex.en: She has a degree in economics.
ex.zh: 她有經濟學學位。

senses.en: It's 30 degrees today.

ex.en: You will receive a certificate after the course.
ex.zh: 課程結束後你會拿到證書。

syn.note: license 是從事某工作的許可

ex.en: Can you provide two references?
ex.zh: 你可以提供兩位推薦人嗎？

syn.note: referee 為英式說法，指提供推薦的人
recommendation 指推薦的內容或推薦信

ex.en: The company recruits graduates every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年都招募畢業生。

syn.note: hire 指正式錄用；recruit 指招募的過程
enlist 原指從軍，也指爭取他人協助

ex.en: Your employer will pay for the training.
ex.zh: 你的雇主會支付訓練費用。

syn.note: company 指公司本身；employer 強調雇用關係

coll.zh: 提供平等就業機會的雇主

ex.en: We are looking for a full-time accountant.
ex.zh: 我們在找一位全職會計。

ex.en: She works part-time at a bookstore.
ex.zh: 她在書店兼職。

ex.en: We signed a two-year contract.
ex.zh: 我們簽了兩年的合約。

syn.note: agreement 可以是口頭的；contract 是有法律效力的書面合約
deal 口語，指談成的生意

ex.en: We hired two temporary workers for the holiday season.
ex.zh: 我們為假期旺季雇了兩名臨時工。

syn.note: provisional 較正式，指之後會再確定

ex.en: She was offered a permanent position.
ex.zh: 她獲得正式職位。

ex.en: He started his career as a sales assistant.
ex.zh: 他從業務助理開始職業生涯。

syn.note: profession 多指需專業訓練的職業

ex.en: Teaching is a demanding profession.
ex.zh: 教書是一份很辛苦的職業。

syn.note: career 強調一生的工作發展

ex.en: We are looking for a qualified engineer.
ex.zh: 我們在找一位合格的工程師。

syn.note: eligible 強調符合申請或參加的條件

ex.en: What qualifications are required for this role?
ex.zh: 這個職位需要什麼資格？

syn.note: requirement 是職缺要求的條件；qualification 是應徵者具備的資格
credential 指證書、學歷等證明文件

ex.en: A college degree is a requirement for this job.
ex.zh: 大學學歷是這份工作的必要條件。

ex.en: Training new staff is one of my responsibilities.
ex.zh: 訓練新員工是我的職責之一。

ex.en: It is my duty to check the safety equipment.
ex.zh: 檢查安全設備是我的職責。

senses.en: You may have to pay duty on these goods.

ex.en: She played a key role in the project.
ex.zh: 她在這個專案中扮演關鍵角色。

ex.en: What is your job title?
ex.zh: 你的職稱是什麼？

ex.en: Please contact the personnel department.
ex.zh: 請聯絡人事部門。

syn.note: staff 較口語；personnel 較正式，也指人事部門
HR 是現代常用說法，等同 personnel department

ex.en: Please send your resume to human resources.
ex.zh: 請把履歷寄給人資部。

usage: 常縮寫為 HR

ex.en: New employee orientation starts at 9 a.m.
ex.zh: 新人說明會早上九點開始。

syn.note: induction 英式用法，指新人入職訓練

ex.en: Annual evaluations are held in December.
ex.zh: 年度考核在十二月舉行。

syn.note: assessment 常用於測驗或風險評估
review 常指 performance review 年度考核

ex.en: Her performance this year has been excellent.
ex.zh: 她今年的表現非常好。

syn.note: results 指具體數字或結果

ex.en: New employees have a three-month probation.
ex.zh: 新員工有三個月的試用期。

syn.note: trial period 也用於免費試用產品

ex.en: He was transferred to the Tokyo office.
ex.zh: 他被調到東京辦公室。

syn.note: relocate 強調搬到另一個城市或地點

ex.en: A staff member will show you to your room.
ex.zh: 會有一位員工帶您到房間。

ex.en: The company plans to reduce its workforce by 5 percent.
ex.zh: 公司計畫裁減 5% 的員工。

syn.note: labor force 多指一國的勞動人口

ex.en: The hiring manager will contact you next week.
ex.zh: 招聘主管下週會跟你聯絡。

syn.note: recruiter 負責找人選，hiring manager 決定錄用誰

ex.en: There are several job openings in our sales department.
ex.zh: 我們業務部有幾個職缺。

ex.en: We have a vacancy for a sales manager.
ex.zh: 我們有一個業務經理的職缺。

senses.en: The hotel has no vacancies.

usage: 飯店門口 No Vacancy＝客滿

ex.en: He is planning his retirement party.
ex.zh: 他正在規劃自己的退休派對。

ex.en: She is attending a conference in Singapore.
ex.zh: 她正在新加坡參加研討會。

syn.note: meeting 規模小、日常；conference 規模大，常有多場議程
convention 指大型年會、展覽型大會

ex.en: I'm giving a presentation on sales results.
ex.zh: 我要做一場銷售成果簡報。

syn.note: demonstration 指實際操作示範產品

ex.en: The CEO gave a speech at the annual meeting.
ex.zh: 執行長在年會上發表演講。

syn.note: address 較正式，多用於重要場合

ex.en: Our guest speaker today is a famous economist.
ex.zh: 今天的客座講者是一位知名經濟學家。

senses.en: The speakers are too loud.

ex.en: The audience applauded at the end of the speech.
ex.zh: 演講結束時觀眾鼓掌。

syn.note: spectators 多指看比賽的觀眾
viewers 指看電視或影片的人

usage: audience 是集合名詞

ex.en: All managers must attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 所有經理都必須出席會議。

syn.note: be present at 較正式，強調在場
go to 口語；attend 正式

ex.en: All attendees will receive a free bag.
ex.zh: 所有出席者都會拿到一個免費的袋子。

ex.en: Each participant will receive a certificate.
ex.zh: 每位參加者都會獲得證書。

syn.note: attendee 指出席活動的人；participant 強調參與其中

ex.en: We need to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 我們需要討論預算。

syn.note: talk about 口語；discuss 不加 about

ex.en: We had a long discussion about the budget.
ex.zh: 我們針對預算討論了很久。

usage: discuss 後面不接 about；discussion 後接 about

ex.en: The main topic of today's meeting is the new budget.
ex.zh: 今天會議的主要議題是新預算。

syn.note: theme 指作品或活動的中心思想

ex.en: That's a great idea!
ex.zh: 那是個好主意！

ex.en: If you have any questions, please call me.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請打電話給我。

senses.en: Some people questioned the decision.

syn.note: query 多用於書面或資料查詢

ex.en: Could you answer the phone, please?
ex.zh: 可以請你接一下電話嗎？

usage: answer 直接接受詞，不加 to

ex.en: I suggest that we meet again next week.
ex.zh: 我建議我們下週再開會。

senses.en: The results suggest that sales will rise.

syn.note: recommend 多用於推薦人、事物
propose 較正式，多指提出計畫

usage: suggest that 後的動詞用原形：suggest that he go

ex.en: Do you have any suggestions for the event?
ex.zh: 你對這個活動有什麼建議嗎？

syn.note: advice 不可數，指給別人的忠告

ex.en: I agree with you about the new design.
ex.zh: 我同意你對新設計的看法。

usage: agree with 人；agree to 提議；agree on 細節

ex.en: Some members disagreed with the plan.
ex.zh: 有些成員不同意這個計畫。

syn.note: object 語氣較強，常加 to

ex.en: In my opinion, we should hire more staff.
ex.zh: 在我看來，我們應該多雇一些員工。

ex.en: We decided to postpone the trip.
ex.zh: 我們決定延後這趟旅行。

ex.en: The manager will make a final decision tomorrow.
ex.zh: 經理明天會做最後決定。

ex.en: The board voted to approve the merger.
ex.zh: 董事會投票通過合併案。

syn.note: elect 指選出某人擔任職位
ballot 指投票用紙或投票方式

ex.en: What are your plans for the weekend?
ex.zh: 你週末有什麼計畫？

ex.en: The board approved the proposal.
ex.zh: 董事會通過了這項提案。

syn.note: plan 泛指打算；proposal 是提出供人考慮或核准的方案

ex.en: Please send me a short summary of the meeting.
ex.zh: 請寄給我一份會議的簡短摘要。

ex.en: Let me summarize the main points.
ex.zh: 讓我總結一下重點。

syn.note: sum up 較口語，常用於結尾 To sum up

ex.en: Could you explain how this machine works?
ex.zh: 你可以說明這台機器怎麼運作嗎？

syn.note: clarify 指把不清楚的地方講清楚
describe 指說明外觀或經過

usage: explain 後不能直接接人：explain it to me

ex.en: Please describe the problem in detail.
ex.zh: 請詳細描述問題。

syn.note: depict 多用於藝術或文字描寫

ex.en: Let me introduce our new manager, Ms. Wang.
ex.zh: 讓我介紹我們的新經理王小姐。

ex.en: Please look at the next slide.
ex.zh: 請看下一張投影片。

senses.en: Prices slid by 3 percent.

ex.en: This chart shows our sales over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表顯示我們過去一年的銷售。

syn.note: graph 多指折線或座標圖

ex.en: The graph shows a steady increase in sales.
ex.zh: 曲線圖顯示銷售穩定成長。

ex.en: The presentation will be shown on a large screen.
ex.zh: 簡報會在大螢幕上播放。

senses.en: All applicants are screened carefully.

ex.en: The projector in Room B isn't working.
ex.zh: B 會議室的投影機壞了。

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone.
ex.zh: 請對著麥克風說話。

ex.en: Please refer to the handout.
ex.zh: 請參考講義。

syn.note: printout 指從電腦印出的資料

ex.en: Who will take the minutes today?
ex.zh: 今天誰負責做會議記錄？

syn.note: notes 指個人筆記，較不正式

ex.en: Is there room for one more person?
ex.zh: 還有空間再坐一個人嗎？

senses.en: There is room for improvement.

syn.note: space 較廣，可數或不可數

usage: room 作「空間」不可數

ex.en: I'd like to reserve a table for four.
ex.zh: 我想訂一張四人桌。

senses.en: cash reserves

ex.en: I booked a table for four.
ex.zh: 我訂了四人的位子。

ex.en: The flight was canceled due to weather.
ex.zh: 班機因天候取消。

syn.note: call off 口語，常用於活動、會議

ex.en: There is a two-hour delay.
ex.zh: 延誤了兩個小時。

ex.en: Can we reschedule the call to Monday?
ex.zh: 我們可以把電話會議改到星期一嗎？

syn.note: postpone 只能往後延；reschedule 可提前或延後

ex.en: The project will end in December.
ex.zh: 專案將在十二月結束。

ex.en: The manager gave a brief speech.
ex.zh: 經理做了簡短的發言。

senses.en: She briefed the team on the new plan.

ex.en: We are short of staff this week.
ex.zh: 我們這週人手不足。

ex.en: The meeting was too long.
ex.zh: 這場會議太長了。

ex.en: The morning session starts at nine.
ex.zh: 早上的場次九點開始。

ex.en: She attended a workshop on time management.
ex.zh: 她參加了一場時間管理研習會。

senses.en: He fixed the chair in his workshop.

ex.en: The company is holding a seminar on online marketing.
ex.zh: 公司正在舉辦網路行銷講座。

ex.en: Professor Lin will give a lecture on economics.
ex.zh: 林教授將發表一場經濟學演講。

senses.en: My boss lectured me about being late.

ex.en: The CEO will give the keynote speech.
ex.zh: 執行長將發表主題演講。

syn.note: main speech 是描述性說法

ex.en: The venue holds up to 300 people.
ex.zh: 會場最多可容納 300 人。

syn.note: location 泛指位置；venue 指活動舉辦場地
site 常指工地或特定用途的地點

ex.en: Please register for the seminar online.
ex.zh: 請上網報名研討會。

ex.en: Registration for the conference closes on Friday.
ex.zh: 會議報名週五截止。

syn.note: enrollment 多用於課程或學校

ex.en: Refreshments will be served after the talk.
ex.zh: 演講結束後會提供茶點。

ex.en: The main objective is to cut costs.
ex.zh: 主要目標是降低成本。

syn.note: goal 最常用；objective 較正式，指具體可衡量的目標

ex.en: Our goal is to increase sales by 20 percent.
ex.zh: 我們的目標是讓業績成長 20%。

senses.en: He scored two goals.

syn.note: target 常指具體數字目標

ex.en: We'd appreciate your input on this plan.
ex.zh: 我們很希望聽到你對這個計畫的意見。

syn.note: feedback 指對已完成事物的評語；input 指事前提供的意見
contribution 指付出的心力或金錢

ex.en: We welcome your feedback.
ex.zh: 歡迎您提供意見。

ex.en: Could you clarify what you mean?
ex.zh: 你可以釐清一下你的意思嗎？

syn.note: explain 泛指說明；clarify 是把模糊之處講清楚

ex.en: The report highlights three key risks.
ex.zh: 這份報告強調了三項主要風險。

syn.note: stress 常用於口說 I want to stress that...

ex.en: She pointed out an error in the report.
ex.zh: 她指出報告中的一個錯誤。

syn.note: mention 只是順帶提起，沒有特別強調

ex.en: I'll follow up with an email.
ex.zh: 我會再寄一封電子郵件追蹤後續。

syn.note: pursue 較正式，有持續追求的意味

ex.en: We agreed on a new deadline.
ex.zh: 我們對新的截止日達成共識。

syn.note: settle on 指經考慮後選定
decide on 可以是一個人決定，不一定是共識

ex.en: We finally reached a consensus.
ex.zh: 我們終於達成了共識。

syn.note: agreement 可指兩方；consensus 強調群體的普遍共識
accord 較正式，常見於國際協定

ex.en: Let's brainstorm ideas for the campaign.
ex.zh: 我們來為這次宣傳活動腦力激盪。

syn.note: generate ideas 是描述性說法

ex.en: The store sells electronics and home appliances.
ex.zh: 這家店販售電子產品和家電。

syn.note: retail 指賣給一般消費者

usage: sell 三態：sell, sold, sold

ex.en: The store is having a sale this weekend.
ex.zh: 這家店這週末有特賣。

syn.note: discount 指價格減少的部分

usage: on sale 常指「特價中」，for sale 指「待售」

ex.en: Sales increased by 15 percent last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季業績成長了 15%。

ex.en: I bought a new laptop yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天買了一台新筆電。

usage: buy 三態：buy, bought, bought

ex.en: We always try to make our customers happy.
ex.zh: 我們總是努力讓顧客滿意。

syn.note: client 多指購買專業服務的客戶
consumer 指一般使用產品的人

ex.en: We have a meeting with a new client.
ex.zh: 我們跟一位新客戶有會議。

syn.note: customer 指購買商品；client 指購買專業服務（律師、顧問）
account 指廣告、業務上的客戶（大客戶 key account）

ex.en: We will launch three new products this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年將推出三項新產品。

ex.en: The hotel provides excellent service.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供很棒的服務。

senses.en: The car needs to be serviced.

ex.en: The price includes breakfast.
ex.zh: 價格包含早餐。

senses.en: The new phone is priced at $500.

ex.en: The total cost of the project is $50,000.
ex.zh: 這個專案的總成本是五萬美元。

usage: cost 三態同形：cost, cost, cost

ex.en: This hotel is cheap but clean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店便宜又乾淨。

syn.note: inexpensive 較禮貌，沒有品質差的意思

ex.zh: 這筆訂單分兩箱寄出。

ex.en: We must address this issue immediately.
ex.zh: 我們必須立即處理這個問題。

syn.note: handle 常指處理具體事務或客訴

ex.en: I travel to Japan for work twice a year.
ex.zh: 我一年因公去日本兩次。

syn.note: journey 強調長途移動的過程

usage: travel 多不可數，一趟用 a trip

ex.en: How was your business trip to Seoul?
ex.zh: 你去首爾出差順利嗎？

ex.en: She is on a business trip this week.
ex.zh: 她這週出差。

ex.en: Our flight was delayed by two hours.
ex.zh: 我們的班機延誤兩小時。

ex.en: I'll pick you up at the airport.
ex.zh: 我會去機場接你。

ex.en: Which airline are you flying with?
ex.zh: 你搭哪家航空公司？

ex.en: The plane landed safely.
ex.zh: 飛機安全降落。

syn.note: aircraft 較正式，單複數同形

ex.en: I bought two tickets for the concert.
ex.zh: 我買了兩張演唱會門票。

syn.note: pass 指可多次使用的票

ex.en: Your passport must be valid for six months.
ex.zh: 護照效期必須在六個月以上。

ex.en: Do I need a visa to visit Canada?
ex.zh: 去加拿大需要簽證嗎？

ex.en: You may bring one piece of carry-on luggage.
ex.zh: 你可以攜帶一件隨身行李。

syn.note: baggage 美式、航空常用，意思相同

ex.en: Please collect your baggage at carousel 5.
ex.zh: 請到 5 號轉盤領取行李。

syn.note: luggage 意思相同，英式較常用

usage: baggage 不可數

ex.en: My suitcase was damaged during the flight.
ex.zh: 我的行李箱在飛行途中受損了。

ex.en: Would you like a bag for that?
ex.zh: 需要幫你裝袋嗎？

ex.en: We stayed at a hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我們住在車站附近的飯店。

ex.en: I have a reservation under the name Chen.
ex.zh: 我用陳的名字訂了位。

syn.note: booking 英式常用，意思相同

ex.en: You can check in online 24 hours before.
ex.zh: 你可以提前 24 小時線上報到。

ex.en: Guests must check out by 11 a.m.
ex.zh: 房客須在上午 11 點前退房。

senses.en: Check out our new website!

ex.en: Please leave your key at the front desk.
ex.zh: 請把鑰匙交到櫃台。

ex.en: Hotel guests can use the pool for free.
ex.zh: 飯店房客可免費使用泳池。

ex.en: How long will you stay in London?
ex.zh: 你會在倫敦待多久？

syn.note: visit 指去某處短暫停留

ex.en: The room costs $120 per night.
ex.zh: 房間一晚 120 美元。

ex.en: We took a tour of the factory.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了工廠。

ex.en: The guide will meet us at the hotel.
ex.zh: 導遊會在飯店和我們會合。

ex.en: Could you show me where we are on the map?
ex.zh: 你可以在地圖上指出我們在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: The city has a good public transportation system.
ex.zh: 這座城市大眾運輸系統很好。

ex.en: How many countries have you visited?
ex.zh: 你去過幾個國家？

syn.note: nation 強調人民與政治實體

ex.en: The hotel is a five-minute walk from the station.
ex.zh: 飯店離車站走路五分鐘。

ex.en: I take the bus to work.
ex.zh: 我搭公車上班。

syn.note: coach 多指長途或遊覽車

ex.en: Let's take a taxi to the airport.
ex.zh: 我們搭計程車去機場吧。

ex.en: I'll park the car in front of the building.
ex.zh: 我會把車停在大樓前面。

senses.en: The dining car is at the back.

syn.note: vehicle 較正式，泛指各種車

ex.en: We rented a car for the trip.
ex.zh: 我們為這趟旅行租了一台車。

syn.note: lease 指長期正式的租約

ex.en: Car rental is included in the package.
ex.zh: 套裝行程包含租車。

syn.note: hire 英式用法 car hire

ex.en: It's a two-hour drive to the city.
ex.zh: 到市區要開兩小時車。

senses.en: Save the file to a USB drive.

ex.en: The road is closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 這條路因維修而封閉。

ex.en: The bank is across the street.
ex.zh: 銀行在對街。

syn.note: avenue 多用於市區大街名

ex.en: I was late because of heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 我因為塞車遲到了。

usage: traffic 不可數

ex.en: The train departs at 8:15.
Please arrive one hour before departure.
ex.zh: 請在出發前一小時抵達。

ex.en: Tokyo is a popular travel destination.
ex.zh: 東京是熱門的旅遊目的地。

ex.en: Flight 302 is now boarding at Gate 12.
ex.zh: 302 班機現在在 12 號門登機。

ex.en: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
ex.zh: 請在登機門出示登機證。

ex.en: Is this seat taken?
ex.zh: 這個位子有人坐嗎？

senses.en: The hall seats 300 people.

ex.en: Would you like an aisle seat?
ex.zh: 您想要靠走道的座位嗎？

ex.en: I'd like a window seat, please.
ex.zh: 我想要靠窗的座位。

ex.en: I'll email you the travel itinerary.
ex.zh: 我會把行程表寄給你。

ex.en: The price includes accommodation.
ex.zh: 價格包含住宿。

ex.en: How much is the bus fare?
ex.zh: 公車車資多少？

ex.en: A round-trip ticket is cheaper.
ex.zh: 來回票比較便宜。

syn.note: return 英式用法 a return ticket

ex.en: A one-way ticket costs $80.
ex.zh: 單程票是 80 美元。

ex.en: I missed my connecting flight.
ex.zh: 我錯過了轉機航班。

ex.en: We went through customs quickly.
ex.zh: 我們很快就通過了海關。

ex.en: My commute takes about an hour.
ex.zh: 我通勤大約要一個小時。

ex.en: Public transportation is very convenient here.
ex.zh: 這裡的大眾運輸很方便。

syn.note: transit 多指大眾運輸系統

ex.en: We joined a half-day excursion.
ex.zh: 我們參加了半日遊。

ex.en: Breakfast is complimentary.
ex.zh: 早餐免費。

syn.note: free 一般用法；complimentary 較禮貌、正式
on the house 口語，指店家請客

ex.en: The hotel has excellent amenities.
ex.zh: 這間飯店的設施很完善。

ex.en: We went sightseeing after the conference.
ex.zh: 會議結束後我們去觀光。

ex.en: I bought some souvenirs for my coworkers.
ex.zh: 我買了些紀念品給同事。

ex.en: She studied abroad for two years.
ex.zh: 她出國念了兩年書。

usage: abroad 是副詞，不加 to

ex.en: The company has many overseas customers.
ex.zh: 公司有很多海外客戶。

ex.en: We buy vegetables from local farmers.
ex.zh: 我們向當地農民買蔬菜。

syn.note: regional 範圍比 local 大

ex.en: The factory produces 10,000 units a day.
ex.zh: 工廠一天生產一萬件。

syn.note: plant 常用於大型工廠或發電廠
mill 指紡織廠、造紙廠等

ex.en: The company is building a new plant.
ex.zh: 公司正在興建新工廠。

ex.en: The machine needs to be cleaned every day.
ex.zh: 機器每天都需要清潔。

syn.note: device 多指小型電子產品

ex.en: The factory uses heavy machinery.
ex.zh: 工廠使用重型機械。

syn.note: machinery 是集合名詞，machines 可數

ex.en: The lab bought new equipment.
ex.zh: 實驗室買了新設備。

syn.note: gear 口語，指運動或戶外裝備

ex.en: We use this tool to repair the machine.
ex.zh: 我們用這個工具修理機器。

syn.note: instrument 多指精密或醫療器具
device 指有特定功能的裝置

ex.en: We are waiting for a replacement part.
ex.zh: 我們在等替換零件。

usage: take part in＝participate in

ex.en: The plant produces car parts.
ex.zh: 這間工廠生產汽車零件。

senses.en: The store sells fresh produce.

usage: 名詞 produce /ˈproʊdus/ 指蔬果農產品

ex.en: Production will start next month.
ex.zh: 下個月開始生產。

ex.en: The company makes office furniture.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產辦公家具。

usage: make 三態：make, made, made

ex.en: They are building a new factory.
ex.zh: 他們正在蓋一座新工廠。

usage: build 三態：build, built, built

ex.en: The parts are assembled in Vietnam.
ex.zh: 零件在越南組裝。

ex.en: We use recycled materials.
ex.zh: 我們使用回收材料。

ex.en: The box is made of metal.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是金屬做的。

ex.en: Please don't use plastic bags.
ex.zh: 請不要使用塑膠袋。

ex.en: The table is made of wood.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是木頭做的。

ex.en: Please be careful with the glass door.
ex.zh: 請小心玻璃門。

syn.note: cup 多指有把手的杯子

ex.en: We only sell high-quality products.
ex.zh: 我們只賣高品質的產品。

ex.en: Inspectors inspect the products daily.
ex.zh: 檢查員每天檢查產品。

ex.en: The building passed the safety inspection.
ex.zh: 大樓通過了安全檢查。

ex.en: All products are tested before shipping.
ex.zh: 所有產品出貨前都經過測試。

ex.en: Please keep your passport in a safe place.
ex.zh: 請把護照放在安全的地方。

senses.en: There is a safe in the hotel room.

syn.note: secure 強調防止損失或入侵

ex.en: Wear safety glasses at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時配戴安全護目鏡。

syn.note: security 指防止犯罪或入侵

ex.en: There is a danger of fire in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房有火災危險。

syn.note: risk 指可能發生的損失

ex.en: It is dangerous to use the machine without gloves.
ex.zh: 不戴手套使用機器很危險。

syn.note: hazardous 較正式，多指化學物質

ex.en: Please be careful when you lift heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬重箱子時請小心。

ex.en: The printer is broken again.
ex.zh: 印表機又壞了。

syn.note: out of order 多用於公共設備

ex.en: The technician will repair the air conditioner tomorrow.
ex.zh: 技術人員明天會來修冷氣。

syn.note: mend 多指衣物或小東西

ex.en: Can you fix my computer?
ex.zh: 你能修我的電腦嗎？

senses.en: Let's fix a time for the meeting.

ex.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance.
ex.zh: 電梯因維修保養暫停使用。

syn.note: upkeep 指維持費用或保養

ex.en: Only trained staff may operate this machine.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的員工才能操作這台機器。

syn.note: run 較口語，run a business / the machine is running
work 指機器正常運作（It doesn't work.）

ex.en: The machine operator checks the output every hour.
ex.zh: 機器操作員每小時檢查一次產量。

senses.en: Please hold and the operator will connect you.

ex.en: The factory has about 500 workers.
ex.zh: 這間工廠有大約 500 名工人。

ex.en: The engineer is checking the new equipment.
ex.zh: 工程師正在檢查新設備。

senses.en: The car was engineered in Germany.

ex.en: We hired a firm to design our new logo.
ex.zh: 我們請了一家公司設計新標誌。

ex.en: We manufacture auto parts.
ex.zh: 我們製造汽車零件。
